text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: manifest v2.14 -> deployment/encoder-service (canary 10%)

alice: seeing crashloops on encoder-canary-0, logs show OOMKilled and failing init with mount error. :rotating_light:

alice: logs snippet: ```kubectl logs encoder-canary-0 -c encoder
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.main() ...
```

eng_jamie: suspect the new env var ENABLE_PREFETCH=true combined with reduced memory request. Also HPA minReplicas=0 + aggressive targetCPU might have allowed scale-to-zero then spike.

sre_tiger: taking pager. are we seeing customer-facing errors?

pm_lina: 3 customers in eu are reporting 503s for inference; synthetic checks show ~80% error rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1.

oncall_may: oncall here, i'll coordinate mitigation. recommend killing traffic to canary and pausing the rollout. deploy-bot, can you pause?

deploy-bot: Rollout paused (manual stop) by oncall_may

eng_jamie: fastest mitigation is flipping feature flag 'prefetch_v2' off (instant). rollback will take longer due to rollout time windows.

infra_rod: flipping flag via internal API now: `curl -s -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d 'prefetch_v2=false'`

infra_rod: flag flip applied. verifying routing — canary traffic should be 0 now.

alice: confirmed: canary still crashlooping but traffic diverted -> customer errors dropping, synthetics down to ~1% errors.

sre_tiger: good. we still need to roll back the bad manifest and fix the hpa/minReplicas. plan: rollback canary to v2.13, update deployment requests/limits and correct liveness probe path.

eng_jamie: preparing patched manifest. root causes identified: memory request accidentally lowered (8Gi -> 6Gi) and livenessProbe path uses /healthz but app uses /ready. will patch helm chart and hpa.

oncall_may: proceed with rollback after verification. who will run kubectl/helm?

eng_jamie: i'll run it. commands i'll use: ```helm rollback encoder-service 3 --namespace=prod && kubectl patch hpa encoder-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'```

deploy-bot: Rollback queued by eng_jamie

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: encoder-service -> v2.13

infra_rod: patched HPA minReplicas applied (minReplicas=2).

alice: monitoring: no new crashloops, pods stable, CPU and memory within expected ranges.

pm_lina: customer impact summary for support: two customers saw brief failures ~5m, one customer experienced ~12m outage. preparing notif.

oncall_may: moving to post-incident review. action items: eng_jamie to fix manifest + add rollout guard preventing minReplicas=0 for critical services; infra_rod to add flag-toggle runbook and ensure flag flip audits; alice to add synthetic checks for prefetch feature and a canary-health monitor. i'll file the incident ticket with timestamps and affected customers.

eng_jamie: noted. i'll also add an automated canary traffic cutoff that flips the flag if crashloop rate > 10% for 2m.

sre_tiger: closing pager. :white_check_mark:
